name: Harshil Agrotech Limited
about: Harshil Agrotech Limited engages in the trading of agriculture goods and commodity and agri materials in India. It provides contract farming, greenhouse technology, modern agro farming, and organic farming services. The company was formerly known as Mirch Technologies (India) Limited and changed its name to Harshil Agrotech Limited in September 2023. Harshil Agrotech Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
